# Hushfield

Hushfield is an ambient sound app for iPhone and Android designed for sleep, focus, relaxation, and noise masking. A growing library of atmospheres; mixes layer up to four sounds; a sleep timer fades audio out gradually.

- Website: https://hushfield.xyz/
- Product: https://hushfield.xyz/product.md
- Privacy: https://hushfield.xyz/privacy/
- Terms: https://hushfield.xyz/terms/
- Support: https://hushfield.xyz/support/
